From the price sheet — read these to the family

  • Companion niche, and why only the Interlude Urn fits. Sold as a companion niche (2 inurnment rights). Due to niche size, the Interlude Urn is required — two fit per niche. The Interlude Urn (Matthews) is $665 each on the urn price list — merchandise, not a fee.
  • Sheet, verbatim: “All Niches Sold as Companions (2) and includes one niche vase”
  • Sheet, verbatim: “ONLY the Interlude Urn is allowed in these Niches due to size. Refer to URN price list for price.” The urn price list figure is Interlude Urn (Matthews) $665.00 each — merchandise, not a fee, and up to 2 per niche.
  • Sheet, verbatim: “E.C.F: 10% — ***E.C.F is not included in listed pricing***”
  • NO PHOTOS ALLOWED

Fee schedule — where these numbers come from

  • Open & Closing $875.00ea  ·  Recording Fee $235.00ea  ·  Inscription $660.00ea + 10.4% sales tax on the inscription alone  ·  E.C.F. 10%
  • These are the Mountain View Columbarium, June 2026 schedule, applied to the Garden of Meditation by operator ruling on 2026-07-31. They are not printed on this area’s own sheet — that sheet prints Open & Closing $835 · Recording Fee $225 · Inscription $605, which these amounts replace. Confirm the current charges in MIS/Enterprise before quoting.
  • The E.C.F. rate is the one fee figure still taken from this sheet, and it is unchanged at 10%.
  • Two inscriptions may be added to the front of a companion niche — the quantity box above goes to 2.
NOTE: NEW PROPERTY PRICES EFFECTIVE JANUARY 30, 2025
Row A is the bottom row; Row G the top. Spaces are numbered 1–32 left to right across the whole wall.
References read GOM-1-1-<row>-<space>. 168 niches; 37 carry a price on the current sheet.
A niche with no printed price is not quotable here — confirm it in MIS/Enterprise. Availability is maintained by hand; always confirm before writing.
